title: Opening a Northbeam Credit Account and Changing Its Limit
content:
An account of the Northbeam Store Credit and Financing Accounts range is opened, and a limit changed, only against a request standing as consented by the customer for that account, because the credit check needs the customer's own agreement.

## 1. The standards

1.1 The product's entry gate is read against the profile: the least age, the kind of credit check, the trade references a business product needs and the prior account months a step-up product needs.

1.2 Identity documents are checked before any account is opened, and a business account additionally names its authorised buyers up to the product's buyer places.

1.3 The limit is written inside the product's band.

1.4 A limit increase is considered only after the product's review months have run on the account and, where the product requires it, the stated income has been checked.

1.5 An application that fails the gate is closed as declined rather than left open, and the customer is told which product their profile does meet.

## 2. The consent the standards rest on

The consent is a matter of record, not of conversation: the authority is the account's own request record standing as consented by the customer, and the customer's agreement given on the call is not that record. It is read before the account is opened or the limit changed, never afterwards. The consent must stand on the request naming that same account; a consent standing on a request that names another account of the same profile is not that account's consent. The income the customer has stated is part of the same request record.

## 3. Condition, judgement and result

| Condition | Judgement | Result |
|---|---|---|
| A request for the account stands as consented by the customer | the authority to run the credit check is in place | the account may be opened or the limit changed |
| No consented request stands for that account | the authority is absent | the account is not opened and the limit is not changed |
| The profile meets every part of the product's entry gate | the application qualifies for that product | the application proceeds and the account is opened for spending once the checks are complete |
| The profile fails a part of the gate | the application does not qualify | it is closed as declined, and the customer is told which product their profile does meet |
| The product's review months have run on the account, and stated income has been checked where the product requires it | the increase may be considered | the new limit is written, and never above the product's largest limit |

## 4. Two readings at the boundary

An application taken and not yet decided stands awaiting a decision, and becomes an account open for spending only once the checks are complete; an application that fails the gate leaves that state as a closed record rather than remaining open.

A profile holding two accounts of the range asks for the limit on one of them to be raised, and the consent on file stands on a request naming the other. That consent does not answer for the account in question, because the request must name the same account the change is written to.
